name: sas-graph-explorer
description: Interactive node-link viewer for sas-graph run output (graph.json), wired to SAS source in the editor.

sasGraph.pythonPath.description: Path to a Python interpreter with sas-graph installed. Used both by the graph tools and by SAS Graph: Re-run and Refresh.

commands.title: SAS Graph: Open Graph View (choose graph.json manually)

languageModelTools.name: sas-graph_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the current SAS program's dependency graph (from the latest sas-graph run) for a node by name or type, case-insensitive substring match. Returns matching nodes' id, type, label, and source location. Call this first to get a node id for sas-graph_traceLineage or a variable id for sas-graph_analyzeImpact.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the SAS dependency graph for a dataset, step, macro, or variable by name.

query.description: Substring to match against node label and type.

languageModelTools.name: sas-graph_traceLineage
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Trace structural lineage for a Dataset, Step, or SqlStatement node: what produced it (upstream) and/or what it feeds into (downstream), over reads_dataset/writes_dataset edges. Direction defaults to both. Returns reached nodes split into upstream_nodes/downstream_nodes plus the edges traversed. Get a node id from sas-graph_search first.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Trace what a dataset or step came from, or what it feeds into.

node.description: Full node id, e.g. dataset:sdtm.ae or step:007.

languageModelTools.name: sas-graph_analyzeImpact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Walk the downstream blast radius of a single Variable node: every Step/SqlStatement and derived variable it reaches through reads_variable/writes_variable edges, plus condition/value facts along the way. Variable-level only — for Dataset/Step-level downstream impact use sas-graph_traceLineage with direction=downstream. Get a variable id from sas-graph_search first.
languageModelTools.userDescription: See what a variable's value affects downstream.

variable.description: Full variable node id, e.g. variable:sdtm.ae.aeterm.
